status.preview: Browser preview — data is not saved

dashboard.subtitle: Here is how your business is doing today.
dashboard.noLow: No product is low on stock.
dashboard.premiumText: Cloud sync and AI store scan. Your inventory stays 100% free.

products.title: Products & stock
products.search: Search by name, SKU or barcode…
products.emptyHint: Add your first product to get started.
products.deleteMsg: "{{name}}" will no longer be offered for sale. Past sales and movements are kept.
products.barcodeHint: Scan or type a barcode. A catalog match fills the product name; you can edit it.
products.stockEditHint: Quantity is not edited here: use "Adjust stock" (or a purchase) so the full history is kept.
products.wholesaleHint: Optional. Leave empty: wholesale customers then pay the normal selling price.
products.wholesaleAbove: The wholesale price cannot be higher than the selling price.
products.wholesaleBelowCost: Careful: the wholesale price is below the purchase price.

categories.title: Categories
categories.inUse: {{count}} product(s) use this category. Choose where to move them.

pos.searchPlaceholder: Search a product or scan a barcode…
pos.emptyCartHint: Tap a product or scan a barcode.
pos.savedLocally: Saved on this device. Stock is already updated.
pos.openingFloatHint: Cash in the drawer at the start.
pos.proformaHint: A proforma does not remove stock or take money. It can be turned into a sale later.
pos.trimmedToStock: Quantities adjusted to the available stock.

receipt.disclaimer: Goods sold cannot be returned or exchanged.

customers.subtitle: Purchase history and credit accounts.
customers.emptyHint: Add customers to track their purchases and credit.
customers.deleteMsg: Delete customer "{{name}}"? Their sales history is kept.
customers.tierWholesaleHint: Wholesale prices are applied automatically at the point of sale (normal price for products without a wholesale price).
customers.taxIdHint: Printed on this customer's invoices (schools, companies, institutions).

suppliers.deleteMsg: Delete supplier "{{name}}"? Past purchases are kept.

purchases.subtitle: Goods received and suppliers.
purchases.emptyHint: Record a delivery to increase stock automatically.
purchases.amountPaidHint: Default: fully paid. Less = supplier debt.

movements.subtitle: Full history of stock in/out, and batch tracking.
movements.fefoHint: Sales use the batch that expires first (FEFO). Expired products are never deleted automatically.
movements.writeOffMsg: Write off {{qty}} {{unit}} of "{{name}}" (expired)? A movement will be recorded.

scan.title: AI store scan
scan.subtitle: Photograph your shelves: the AI proposes, you confirm.
scan.onlineNote: Analysis needs internet. Stock is never changed without your confirmation.
scan.cameraError: Camera unavailable. Upload an image instead.
scan.noResultHint: Add an image, then run the analysis.
scan.lockedHint: AI store scan is included in Premium (3,900 FCFA/month). Your inventory stays fully usable.
scan.lockedExpired: Your Premium subscription has expired. Renew to use AI scan again. Your data is not affected.
scan.trialUsed: Your shop has used its free scan. Subscribe to Premium for more scans.
scan.trialAvailable: One free AI shelf scan is available for this shop. Only a successful scan uses it; failed scans do not.
scan.trialSetup: Sign in to your shop cloud account and configure the cloud API in Settings > Synchronization to check this shop's free scan.
scan.trialCheckFailed: The app could not check this shop's free scan. Check the cloud API connection and try again.
scan.trialMainDevice: The free scan is available only on the shop's registered main PC. Use Premium on this PC or open the scan on the main PC.

err.NO_SESSION: Sign in to your cloud account (Settings > Subscription).
err.NETWORK: No internet connection. AI scan needs internet — everything else works normally.
err.AUTH: Session expired. Sign in to the cloud account again.
err.PREMIUM_REQUIRED: The server says Premium is not active.
err.SERVER: The analysis service is unavailable. Try again later.
err.NOT_CONFIGURED: Online services are not available in this version yet.

settings.maxDiscountHint: Applies to authorized managers and cashiers.
settings.demoText: Adds products and 45 days of realistic sales to try the dashboard and insights.
settings.permissionsHint: Check what each role can do. The administrator always has full access.
settings.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep it unchanged.
settings.restoreWarning: Current data will be replaced by the backup's data.
settings.restoreSafety: A copy of your current data is saved automatically first.
settings.logoHint: Converted to black & white for crisp printing. Without a logo, nothing is printed there.
settings.showTime: Show the sale time on the receipt
settings.autoBackupNote: A safety copy is created every day (the latest 14 are kept) on the SAME disk: if the computer is lost or dies, so are they. Export a backup to a USB drive or another computer regularly.
settings.taxRateHint: 0 = no tax line. Selling prices include VAT: it is only itemised on the invoice (19.25 in Cameroon).
settings.invoiceNotes: Text at the bottom of documents

subscription.activeUntil: Premium active until {{date}} ({{days}} days left). Also works offline.
subscription.freeText: Free plan: all inventory, POS, AI and voice are included forever.
subscription.expiredText: Premium expired on {{date}}. Only cloud sync and AI scan are disabled.
subscription.dataSafe: Your local data is never deleted or locked, whatever the subscription status.
subscription.cloudSyncText: Online backup and synchronization across devices.
subscription.storeScanText: Photograph shelves, the AI detects products and proposes quantities.
subscription.adminOnly: Only an administrator can manage the subscription.
subscription.signedIn: Signed in to the cloud account.
subscription.paymentFailed: The payment failed or was declined.

err.NO_SESSION: Sign in to the cloud account first.
err.NETWORK: No internet connection. Payment needs internet; the local app keeps working.
err.SERVER: The server hit an error. Try again.
err.NOT_CONFIGURED: Online services are not available in this version yet.

subscription.planDetail: 30 days · Cloud sync + AI store scan
subscription.phoneHint: Cameroon MTN or Orange number (9 digits). You will receive a payment request on this phone.
subscription.offlineBlock: No internet connection. Payment, cloud sync and AI scan need internet. The rest of the app keeps working offline.
subscription.needsInternet: Both of these features need an internet connection.
subscription.waitingTitle: Approve the payment on your phone
subscription.confirmOnPhone: A {{operator}} payment request was sent to {{phone}}. Enter your PIN code to approve it.
subscription.failedHelp: Nothing is charged until you approve with your PIN. If you did pay, use "Check payment".
subscription.pendingFound: A payment is waiting for confirmation.
subscription.how1: Choose MTN MoMo or Orange Money.
subscription.how2: Enter your phone number then tap "Pay".
subscription.how3: Approve with your PIN on the phone: Premium activates automatically.
subscription.verifyNote: The payment is verified by our servers with Notch Pay. Premium only activates after a signed confirmation.
subscription.timedOut: The time ran out without confirmation.
subscription.serverExplain: StockFlow server address (online backend). Development only: in the final version the address is built into the app and this section is not shown.
subscription.noServerNotice: The cloud connection is not configured for this website. Set VITE_CLOUD_API_URL in the website hosting settings, then redeploy.

sync.premiumOnly: Cloud sync is a Premium feature
sync.premiumOnlyText: Without Premium everything works locally. Your data stays on this device and is never deleted.
sync.trialText: Start one 30-minute shop sync window. It uploads and downloads changes; after it ends, Premium is required to sync again.
sync.trialStarted: Cloud sync trial started. This PC will sync for 30 minutes.
sync.trialFailed: The trial started, but the sync had an issue. Your local data is safe; check the sync status and try again before the window ends.
sync.dataSafe: Your data is intact on this device. Sync will retry automatically.
sync.conflictsHint: When two devices edit the same item, the newest version is kept and the other is preserved here. Nothing is lost silently.
sync.accountHint: Sync sends your data to your online account. Sign in or create one (the subscription itself does not need one).
sync.needAccount: Sign in to the cloud account below to sync.
sync.restoreFreeNote: Restoring from the cloud stays possible without Premium.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.welcome: I am connected to your local data: sales, stock, expiry, insights. Ask a question or give an order (I always ask for confirmation before changing anything).
assistant.ex1: How much did we sell today?
assistant.ex2: What products are low in stock?
assistant.ex4: What should I prepare for tomorrow?
assistant.safety: Any change (sale, stock, price, purchase) is summarized and only executed after you confirm.
assistant.micUnsupported: Speech recognition is not available on this system. Use the keyboard; spoken replies still work.

ai.notAllowed: Your role is not allowed to do this.
ai.unknown: I did not understand. Try for example: "How much did we sell today?", "How much sugar is left?" or "Add 20 units of sugar".
ai.help: I can answer about sales, profit, stock, prices, expiry, best sellers, customers, suppliers, sync, subscription and insights. I can also: add/remove stock, sell, change a price, record a purchase — after your confirmation.
ai.confirmSell: {{qty}} × {{name}} at {{price}} = {{total}}. Stock will decrease by {{qty}} ({{left}} {{unit}} left). Payment: cash. Confirm?
ai.confirmAdd: Add {{qty}} {{unit}} to "{{name}}": stock goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Confirm?
ai.confirmRemove: Remove {{qty}} {{unit}} from "{{name}}": stock goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Confirm?
ai.confirmPrice: Change the price of "{{name}}" from {{from}} to {{to}}. Confirm?
ai.confirmPurchase: Purchase: {{qty}} {{unit}} of "{{name}}" at {{cost}} = {{total}}. Stock goes to {{to}}. Confirm?
ai.profit: Profit {{period}}: gross {{profit}} on {{total}} sales ({{margin}}% margin); expenses {{expenses}}, net profit {{net}}.
ai.lowNone: No product is low on stock.
ai.expiringList: Within {{days}} days: {{soon}} batch(es) expiring soon, {{expired}} already expired:
ai.inventoryValue: Stock value: {{cost}} at cost ({{retail}} at retail) across {{count}} products.
ai.syncDisabled: Cloud sync is a Premium feature. Everything works locally.

sync.OFFLINE: Offline: {{pending}} change(s) waiting, they will be sent when internet returns.
sync.FAILED: The last sync failed. Your data is safe; it will retry automatically.

ai.premiumExpired: Premium has expired. Only cloud sync and AI scan are disabled.
ai.premiumFree: You are on the free plan. Premium (3,900 FCFA/month) adds cloud sync and AI scan.
ai.insightsIntro: Here is what I noticed in your sales:
ai.whyNone: I do not have enough history to recommend anything about "{{name}}".
ai.whyPeak: {{name}} sells mostly on {{day}}: about {{avgPeak}} units that day versus {{avgOther}} on other days.
ai.whyRisk: You only have {{stock}} {{unit}} in stock, which may not cover the usual demand (estimate).
ai.dayNone: No product has a reliable sales peak on {{day}} yet.
ai.dayList: Products that sell most on {{day}} (average that day vs other days):
ai.prepareNone: Nothing in particular to prepare for {{day}} based on your history.
ai.prepare: Based on your past sales, demand is usually higher on {{day}} for: {{names}}.
ai.prepareRisk: Your current stock may not be enough for: {{names}} (estimate).
ai.voiceConfirmHint: Say "yes" to confirm or "no" to cancel.

insight.title: AI insights
insight.notEnough: Not enough sales history to identify a reliable pattern yet.
insight.nothing: No notable pattern yet. Keep selling: the analysis improves over time.

STOCK_RISK.title: You may run short of {{product}} before {{day}}.
STOCK_RISK.detail: Current stock: {{stock}} {{unit}} · usual demand on {{day}}: about {{avgPeak}}.

STOCK_COVER.title: {{product}} stock is short compared with its sales pace.

TREND_UP.title: {{product}} sales increased {{pct}}% this week.
TREND_UP.reco: Consider checking your current stock level.

HOUR_PEAK.title: {{product}} sells mostly between {{from}} and {{to}}.
HOUR_PEAK.detail: {{share}}% of sales fall in this window.

SLOW_MOVER.title: {{product}} is selling slower than usual.
SLOW_MOVER.detail: −{{drop}}% over the last 14 days · {{stock}} {{unit}} in stock.

insights.title: AI insights
insights.subtitle: What your sales reveal: peak days, trends, stock to watch. Computed on this device, no internet needed.
insights.needData: Keep selling: at least {{days}} days of history are needed to detect a reliable pattern.
insights.disclaimer: Recommendations are estimates based on your past sales, not certainties.

voice.title: Voice assistant
voice.subtitle: Talk like to a real colleague: it answers out loud and asks for confirmation before changing anything.
voice.tapToTalk: Tap the mic to talk (or F8)
voice.sayIt: I am listening… try "How much did we sell today?"
voice.noMic: Microphone not available on this system: type your request below.
voice.conversationHint: After each answer the assistant listens again.
voice.noSpeech: I did not hear anything. Tap the mic and try again.
voice.micDenied: Microphone access denied. Allow the microphone for this app in Windows settings (Privacy > Microphone).
voice.engineFailed: Speech recognition failed. Try again or type your request.

engine.none: Speech recognition unavailable — use the keyboard
engine.modelMissing: The offline voice model was not found.
engine.modelMissingHelp: Offline model not found. Run "npm run voice:model" before building, or put a ggml-*.bin file in:
engine.notCompiled: This build was compiled without the offline engine.
engine.hybrid: Automatic recognition: online when connected, offline (Whisper) otherwise

recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.intro: If you forget the administrator password, this key is the only way back into the app without losing your data. It is shown only once.
recovery.warning: Print it and keep it somewhere safe (safe, sealed envelope). Anyone with this key can reset the administrator password. Do not share it or leave it next to the computer.
recovery.saved: I have written down my recovery key and stored it safely.
recovery.printNote: Confidential. Lets you reset the administrator password. Single use: a new key is generated after use.
recovery.resetSubtitle: Enter the administrator's recovery key. Works offline; your data is not touched.
recovery.noKeyHelp: Lost the key? If another administrator exists, they can reset your password in Settings > Users. Otherwise contact your provider.
recovery.newKeyText: The old key no longer works. Keep this one safe: it will never be shown again.
recovery.cardExists: A recovery key is active (created on {{date}}).
recovery.cardMissing: No recovery key: if you forget the password you will not be able to sign in.
recovery.cardHint: Generating a new key invalidates the old one. Each use of a key automatically creates a new one.
recovery.bannerText: Create one so you can reset the administrator password if it is forgotten.

restore.link: I already have a cloud account — restore my business
restore.title: Restore from the cloud
restore.subtitle: Get your products, sales, customers, staff accounts and settings back on this new computer.
restore.free: Restoring is free. Only uploading new changes to the cloud needs Premium.
restore.doneNext: Sign in with your old username and password. Then create a new recovery key (Settings > Users).
restore.empty: No data found for this cloud account. Check that you are using the right account.
restore.cardText: Downloads all the data of your cloud account again (products, sales, customers, staff accounts, settings) and merges it with this computer.
restore.needAccount: Sign in to the cloud account above first.
restore.cardConfirmText: Nothing is deleted on this computer: cloud data is added, and when both sides changed the same item the newest version is kept (the other stays visible under Conflicts).

network.title: Shop network
network.intro: Share the same data between the PCs of your shop, without internet. One PC is the main PC and keeps the shop's data; the other PCs connect to it through the router or a network cable.
network.adminOnly: Only the administrator can manage the shop network.
network.hostIntro: Choose one PC that stays on during opening hours. It holds the shop's data and the other PCs connect to it. Do this on ONE PC only.
network.hostConfirm: This PC will share the shop's data on your local network. Windows may ask to allow the app: choose "Private networks". Existing data on this PC is kept and shared.
network.cloudPaused: While on the shop network, this PC syncs with the main PC instead of the cloud.
network.hostOn: This PC is now the main PC.
network.autostartOn: StockFlow starts when you sign in to Windows. Keep it open during shop hours.
network.autostartFailed: The shop network is on, but automatic startup could not be enabled. Try the button on this page.
network.autostartDisableFailed: You left the shop network, but Windows startup could not be disabled. Please disable it from this page before using this PC as a client.
network.offlineText: Checkout is paused until this PC reaches the main PC. Your local data is safe; reconnect to resume sales.
network.offlineTextHost: Checkout is paused while the shop hub is unavailable. Your local data is safe; restore the hub connection to resume sales.
network.addressHint: Shown on the main PC under Settings > Shop network, for example 192.168.1.10
network.mergeWarn: This PC already has its own products or sales. Tick to also add them to the shop's data. Leave unticked to only download the shop's data.
network.clientText: This PC shares its data with the main PC at {{address}}. Changes appear on the other PCs within a few seconds.
network.leaveHost: This PC stops sharing. The other PCs can no longer connect to it.
network.leaveClient: This PC stops syncing with the main PC.
network.dataKept: All data on this PC is kept.
network.addressHelp: Type this address on the other PCs, under Settings > Shop network > Connect.
network.noAddress: No network address found. Connect this PC to the router or a network cable.
network.pairHint: Open pairing, then type the code on the new PC. The code works for 10 minutes.
network.revokeConfirm: This PC will no longer be able to connect. Its own data stays on it.
network.publicText: Windows blocks other PCs from reaching this one on a Public network ({{name}}). Open Settings > Network & Internet, choose the connection and set Network profile to "Private".
network.firewallText: The first time, Windows asks whether to allow StockFlow AI on the network: tick "Private networks" and click Allow. If the other PCs cannot connect, check this and that every PC is on the same router.
network.syncInfo: This PC syncs with the shop's main PC (see Shop network). No subscription is needed for this.
network.backupTrialText: Try one 30-minute upload of this shop to the cloud. Available once for this shop, on its main PC.
network.backupTrialActive: Introductory cloud sync is active until {{date}}.
network.joinLink: Connect to the shop's main PC
network.joinFirstSubtitle: For a new PC in a shop that already uses StockFlow AI.
network.joinDoneNext: Everything was downloaded. Log in with your own account.
network.joinEmpty: Nothing was downloaded. Check that the main PC has data, then try again.

err.NETWORK: Cannot reach the main PC. Check the address, that both PCs are on the same router or cable, and that the main PC is on.
err.NOT_LOCAL: Only addresses on your own network are allowed (like 192.168.1.10).
err.BAD_ADDRESS: This address is not valid. Example: 192.168.1.10
err.NOT_A_HUB: Nothing answered like a StockFlow main PC at this address.
err.PAIRING_CLOSED: Pairing is not open. On the main PC, click "Pair a new PC" and try again.
err.PAIRING_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. On the main PC, open pairing again.
err.UNAUTHORIZED: This PC is no longer paired with the main PC. Connect again.
err.PORT_IN_USE: Another program already uses the sharing port on this PC.
err.HUB_START_FAILED: Sharing could not start on this PC.
err.SERVER: The main PC returned an error. Try again.
err.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong with the shop network.

counts.subtitle: Count what is really on the shelves and fix the stock in one tap.
counts.name: Name (optional)
counts.scopeHint: The whole shop, or one category (one shelf at a time).
counts.blind: Count without seeing the system stock
counts.blindHint: Recommended: you count what you see, without being influenced by the number on screen.
counts.emptyHint: Count from time to time: you will see where stock disappears.
counts.cancelMsg: The count is cancelled and the stock stays exactly as it is. The quantities already entered are not applied.
counts.searchPlaceholder: Scan a barcode or search a product…
counts.notCountedWarn: {{count}} product(s) were not counted: their stock will not be changed.
counts.movedNote: {{count}} product(s) moved since they were counted (sale, purchase). This is fine: only the difference found is corrected, later movements are kept.
counts.noDifferenceHint: Everything you counted matches the system stock.
counts.applyMsg: {{count}} product(s) will be corrected and each correction is recorded in the stock movements with its reason. Products that were not counted do not change. This cannot be undone.
counts.cancelledInfo: This count was cancelled: the stock was not changed.
counts.lossesHint: The losses found by finished counts: the products that come up short most often, and why.
counts.noLossDataHint: Finish a count to see where stock disappears.

documents.subtitle: Printable invoices and quotes (proformas) with sequential numbers.
documents.search: Search a number or a customer…
documents.emptyInvoicesHint: After a sale, tap "Invoice" to create a numbered invoice.
documents.emptyProformasHint: Create a proforma from the till (Proforma mode): no stock or money is touched.
documents.convertMsg: The sale is recorded at the proforma prices, the stock is removed now and the invoice is created. There must be enough stock.
documents.convertConfirm: Create the sale and the invoice
documents.cancelInvoiceMsg: Cancelling an invoice cancels the sale: stock is put back. The invoice number stays in the list as "Cancelled" and is never reused.
documents.cancelProformaMsg: The proforma is marked cancelled. No stock or money is involved.
documents.pickSaleHint: One sale = one invoice. If it already has one, it opens directly.
documents.notAnInvoice: This document is a proforma: it is not an invoice.
